US-Mediated Talks Between Israel and Lebanon Planned for Next Week

The United States is set to mediate direct talks between Israel and Lebanon in Rome next week. These discussions aim to address the ongoing conflict, which has seen Hezbollah draw Lebanon into regional hostilities. The talks are expected to focus on the possibility of a ceasefire.
